armor_options.name: Fragmented Defenses
armor_options.desc: Provides protection against BREACHED but you get a SMALL penalty to SOAK checks.

armor_options.name: Armor-Bot
armor_options.desc: Adds in a DRONE controller that provides 1 CPU that can be use exclusivelly for DRONES

armor_options.name: Autofit
armor_options.desc: Adds the UNIVERSAL trait to an armor

armor_options.name: Compact Design
armor_options.desc: Reduce FORCEFIELD or DATACOM size by 1 category. Cannot reduce an item under TINY.

armor_options.name: Compact-it!
armor_options.desc: Fold your armor as a COMPLEX action when not worn. Folded size for Light, Medium and Heavy armor result into a SMALL, MEDIUM or LARGE item.

armor_options.name: Hardening
armor_options.desc: Adds the HARDENED special property but you get a SMALL penalty to SOAK checks.

armor_options.name: Hazmat Treatment
armor_options.desc: Adds the INNOCULATION special property. This option requires OPT+.

armor_options.name: Heat Coating
armor_options.desc: Adds the INSULATING special property but you get a SMALL penalty to SOAK checks.

armor_options.name: Hidden storage
armor_options.desc: Item now has a SMALL compartment that is hidden. Grants 5 passive CONCEALMENT to anything inside.

armor_options.name: Shatter plates
armor_options.desc: This defense ignores the effect of DP on PHYSICAL damage attacks.

armor_options.name: Reflective deflectors
armor_options.desc: This defense ignores the effect of DP on ENERGY damage attacks.

armor_options.name: Null emissions
armor_options.desc: This defense ignores the effect of DP on TECH damage attacks.

armor_options.name: Warded construction
armor_options.desc: This defense ignores the effect of DP on SPIRITUAL damage attacks.

armor_options.name: Light Plates
armor_options.desc: HEAVY Armors now count as MEDIUM and MEDIUM as LIGHT. Maximum SOAK is permanently reduced by 2.

armor_options.name: Pressurized
armor_options.desc: Gain the SPACE special ability but size increase by 1 category. For armor this increases encumbrance by 1 category.

armor_options.name: Quick escape
armor_options.desc: Removing this ARMOR or FORCEFIELD can be done as a Quick action but you need to spend a SCENE restoring your item before putting it on again.

armor_options.name: Symbiotic Defenses
armor_options.desc: After taking damage you gain a SMALL bonus to SOAK until next maintenance. If the damage caused a TRAUMA the SOAK bonus is LARGE.

armor_options.name: Vital Guard
armor_options.desc: Your DEFENSE is one tier higher on CRITICAL attacks. (Up to a maximum of HIGH).

armor_options.name: Runic
armor_options.desc: Item is treated as an INTERMEDIATE RELIC that lowers CHI penalties.

armor_options.name: Storage format
armor_options.desc: Item can be compacted when not in use (COMPLEX to pack/unpack). Compacting an item reduces it's size by 1 category (Min. TINY).

armor_options.name: Tactical Inserts
armor_options.desc: Grants AEGIS for up to a SCENE but must be recharged after any SCENE where it prevented any SPECIAL modifier. (Recharge takes 3 NANITES and a SCENE).

armor_options.name: Flawless shields
armor_options.desc: This FORCEFIELD can now ignores critical attacks by expending 2 charges per hit instead of one.

armor_options.name: Weapon mount
armor_options.desc: Your armor removes the penalties for RECOIL, if your armored is also POWERED, you remove the penalties for BRACE as well.

armor_options.name: Cloaking
armor_options.desc: Adds the CLOAK special ability to this DEVICE.

armor_options.name: Dead's man switch
armor_options.desc: Item can self destruct on a trigger condition set by its user. Item's explosion deals 10D [HIGH] PHYSICAL HEALTH damage in a 2m radius.

armor_options.name: Displacement field
armor_options.desc: Provides a SMALL bonus to SPEED checks Vs Ranged attacks. Bonus is negated if you are LOCKED ON.

armor_options.name: Distress beacon
armor_options.desc: Can send out a distress signal that can be seen up to 1 system away

armor_options.name: Flickerfield
armor_options.desc: Adds PHASING to your forcefield

armor_options.name: Jump jets
armor_options.desc: Requires a MEDIUM or LARGE item. You can travel in the air for 1 round at a speed of 8 or break a fall once per SCENE. (SCENE recharge)

armor_options.name: Medi-Bot
armor_options.desc: Item can apply a pre installed DRUG on you (lvl 5 Medical) as FREE ACTION. Requires a COMPLEX action to recharge or replace the expended drug.

armor_options.name: Repellent Systems
armor_options.desc: Zap anyone touching this DEVICE as a QUICK action or predetermined (at purchase) trigger. 7D+2 [HIGH] STUN ENERGY HEALTH damage (Scene recharge)

armor_options.name: Ricochet systems
armor_options.desc: Grenades that land within 1m of you have a additional 5m deviation in a random direction.

armor_options.name: S.A.D Module
armor_options.desc: Spike Accident Detector: Deploys on vehicle crash or terminal velocity falls. Adds 8D SOAK on crash. SCENE recharge.

armor_options.name: Spider Harness
armor_options.desc: Harness, ropes and climbing attachment (LARGE bonus to ATHLETICS checks when climbing)

armor_options.name: Spotlights
armor_options.desc: Item has a built in searchlight, brightly illuminates a 45 degree cone at 250m.

armor_options.name: Explorer package armor
armor_options.desc: Your Armor can now filter toxic or dirty water or recycle existing water extending it for 10 days.

armor_options.name: Explorer package forcefield
armor_options.desc: Your forcefield can now filter toxic gases and extract air out of non breatheable gases. It can also recycle existing air for up to 10 hours.

armor_options.name: Explorer package datacom
armor_options.desc: Your Datacom has a set of specialized nanites and attachments that grant a LARGE bonus to SURVIVAL and SCAVENGE skill checks.

armor_options.name: Tactical Visor
armor_options.desc: Provides fully virtual electronic imaging (user has Type II vision instead of Type I).

armor_options.name: Time Dilation
armor_options.desc: When someone enters MELEE range with you time slows down, you and anyone within your melee range is SLOW. Increase FORCEFIELD DEFENSE to HIGH and gain DUELIST against any melee attacker that is SLOW.

armor_options.name: Maintenance mode
armor_options.desc: Device has built in basic tools required to maintain and repair the device. Removes the need for external tools.

armor_options.name: Trauma unit
armor_options.desc: Device will auto stabilize you if you are DYING and can also emit a distress signal on TRAUMA if configured to do so.

armor_options.name: Anti-Papparazzi
armor_options.desc: Your DISCRETE option now grants 10 CONCEALMENT vs Type II devices (Electronic surveillance).

armor_options.name: Auto-Purge
armor_options.desc: Removes any ongoing damage AILMENTS at the end of the maintenance phase if you have not saved against them already.

armor_options.name: Combat tracker
armor_options.desc: Gain a SMALL bonus to all DEFENSES ATTRIBUTES against any target you have LOCK-ON against.

armor_options.name: Cosmetic Package
armor_options.desc: Allows the device to display any design, texture or logo of your choice. Grants a SMALL bonus if used as part of a disguise.

armor_options.name: Sound Dampeners
armor_options.desc: Careful construction and sound dampening grants this item the INV special modifier (undetectable over 10m) against sound identification

armor_options.name: Drone-Controller
armor_options.desc: Provides 1 CPU but usage is limited for DRONE use only.

armor_options.name: EMP shielded
armor_options.desc: Device is protected from ELECTRO MAGNETIC PULSE (EMP). This does not prevent damage.

armor_options.name: Frangible Plating
armor_options.desc: Grants protection against AR for up to a SCENE but is destroyed after any SCENE where it prevented an AR modifier.

armor_options.name: Gravity controller
armor_options.desc: Device now provides artificial gravity for yourself. You can ignore gravity related difficult terrain.

armor_options.name: Lock-on Jammer
armor_options.desc: CYBERINTEL LOCK-ON attacks against you have a LARGE penalty.

armor_options.name: Luxury Package
armor_options.desc: Item is custom made to be as luxurious as possible is now a LUXURY item and it's design is UNIQUE.

armor_options.name: Memory Bank
armor_options.desc: This item has 3 units of MEMORY storage, this storage has CONCEALMENT 5 vs Type 1 and Type 2 surveillance.

armor_options.name: Repair bots
armor_options.desc: Item has repair nanobots. Spend 1 NANITE and a QUICK action to repair the item or cancel a condition preventing its usage like a critical faillure etc.

armor_options.name: Nano-Reserves
armor_options.desc: ITEM increases your NANITE count by 3

armor_options.name: Overcharge
armor_options.desc: While your FORCEFIELD is recharging any ENERGY attacks you make have its POWER level increased by 1.

armor_options.name: Security Package
armor_options.desc: When outside of a NETWORK this device now has a SYSTEM rating of 5 instead of the default 1.

armor_options.name: Spirit Guard
armor_options.desc: When your defenses are not BREACHED, attempts to bind your SPIRIT receives a LARGE penalty.

armor_options.name: Suit-Up!
armor_options.desc: If applied to a LIGHT ARMOR, you can now put it on as a STANDARD action. If applied to a MEDIUM or HEAVY ARMOR, you instead reduce the time to put them on to 1 round and 2 rounds respectivelly.

armor_options.name: Supercharger
armor_options.desc: If both your forcefield and energy weapon have this option, as a QUICK action you can set one non recharging item to recharge to instantly recharge the other one. Both items must have the same recharge time for this to work.

armor_options.name: Tach-Field
armor_options.desc: Item gains the DISCRETE special modifier but the CONCEALMENT is only 1.

armor_options.name: Professional Calibration
armor_options.desc: SMALL penalty to weapon damage but increase EXPERTISE by 3

armor_options.name: Barrel Mount
armor_options.desc: Allows the weapon to attach small non-combat tools like a flashlight. Inceases weapon size by 1.

armor_options.name: Bayonet
armor_options.desc: Your weapon can produce a KNIFE on demand, paramaters are the same as a regular KNIFE except that the KNIFE damage type will match your WEAPONS base damage type as well. This allows your weapon to be used in MELEE without any penalties.

armor_options.name: Combat grip
armor_options.desc: This DEVICE can be used in melee. Counts as a nightstick if the device is SMALL or MEDIUM and a STAFF if it is LARGER. TINY DEVICES cannot have this option.

armor_options.name: Deflection Field
armor_options.desc: Weapon has a deflection field to help against attacks. Grants a frontal only MEDIUM DEFENSE against all damage types while wielding this weapon.

armor_options.name: Compact Folding
armor_options.desc: Weapon can be compacted (reduce size by 1 category but unusable until expanded). Takes a Quick action to change from compact to full.

armor_options.name: Full Stabilizer
armor_options.desc: Your EXPERTISE roll is LUCKY when using FULL AUTO. Weapon size increase by 1

armor_options.name: Grav compensator
armor_options.desc: Removes the BULKY and RECOIL modifier from a weapon. EXPERTISE is reduced by 3.

armor_options.name: Extended magazine
armor_options.desc: Doubles weapon ammo capacity but increase weapon size class by 1.

armor_options.name: Long barrel
armor_options.desc: Increase WEAPON range to maximum in category. Increase weapon size class by 1.

armor_options.name: Reinforced
armor_options.desc: DEVICE gains the DUR+ special option and EXPERTISE can never drop under 0 (No effect if no EXPERTISE or already under 0)

armor_options.name: Short barrel
armor_options.desc: Reduce WEAPON size by 1 category but LONG RANGE is no longer possible and MEDIUM range has a LARGE penalty to hitl.

armor_options.name: Ammo Selector
armor_options.desc: Munition based weapon can select different kind of ammunitions from the same magazine as a free action.

armor_options.name: Singularity generator
armor_options.desc: Radius of EXPLOSIVE weapons can now exclude one 1x1m area from blast radius.

armor_options.name: Fast Charge Cells
armor_options.desc: Once per SCENE you can bypass your DEVICE RECHARGE time. Doing so instantly recharges the device but for the rest of the SCENE your SKILL/DEFENSE check with that DEVICE have their CRITICAL FAILURE treshold increases by 1.

armor_options.name: Virtual imaging
armor_options.desc: You ignore all visual penalities and type II CONCEALMENT. You are BLIND if your INTERNAL SYSTEM reaches 0.

armor_options.name: Heavy Coils
armor_options.desc: Your ENERGY weapon gains the DP tag but not longer shoots above MEDIUM RANGE range and ammo consumption is DOUBLED.

armor_options.name: Guidance system
armor_options.desc: You can add SMART to any munition based weapon attacks by consuming 3x the normal AMMO.

armor_options.name: Multi-Dimention Coils
armor_options.desc: Your ENERGY weapon fire gains the INV tag or INV+ if it already had INV. Expertise is reduced by 3 points.

armor_options.name: Assasination marker
armor_options.desc: When making PRECISION HITS your CRITICAL range increase by 1. Increases by 2 if you also have LOCK-ON. Weapon can no longer CRITICAL hit on non PRECISION HITS.

armor_options.name: Multi-Detonator
armor_options.desc: Allows user to set exact detonation conditions for a SINGLE USE EXPLOSIVE based on almost anything. Explosive size increase to next category.

armor_options.name: Smart Detonation
armor_options.desc: Weapon will not fire or Explosive will not detonate if a friendly targets would be hit. Prevents all friendly fire.

armor_options.name: Speed reloader
armor_options.desc: You can reduce the reload time of AMMO based weapons by 1 action type (COMPLEX-STANDARD-QUICK). This cannot reduce reload under a quick action.

armor_options.name: Interface Implants
armor_options.desc: DEVICE now requires EVO Cybernetics to use. Gain a SMALL bonus to skill checks with that DEVICE if you activated a CYBERNETIC EVO this ROUND. Bonus increases to LARGE if the activation did not cost MORALE.

armor_options.name: Universal receiver
armor_options.desc: You can use any ammo as long as the category is equal or higher, you get no additional benefits from this.

armor_options.name: Auto-Fixit
armor_options.desc: In the case of a reliability malfunction (critical faillure) this DEVICE automatically fixes itself after 1 round.

armor_options.name: Biometric lock
armor_options.desc: DEVICE has a genetic lock and can only be used by owner or a perfect clone of the owner.

armor_options.name: Grenade attachment
armor_options.desc: Adds a Grenade launcher attachment (see Grenade table) to any medium, large or Ex.large weapon.

armor_options.name: High Explosive
armor_options.desc: Increases EXPLOSIVE POWER to HIGH but reduces radius by half (Not usable if radius is reduced under 1m).

armor_options.name: Hypo Darts
armor_options.desc: Needler weapon now fires medical darts. Damage reduced to STUN. Applies drug effect on a damaging hit. DRUG must be acquired separatly. Reduces needler ammo to a maximum of 1.

armor_options.name: Laser Bayonet
armor_options.desc: ENERGY Weapon can now be used in MELEE with a SMALL penalty , damage and POWER remains the same but it does not trigger RETALIATION.

armor_options.name: Long range attachment
armor_options.desc: Eliminate LONG and MEDIUM range penalty when taking a PRECISION HIT action. Weapon size increase by 1 category.

armor_options.name: Serrated delivery
armor_options.desc: If your PHYSICAL DAMAGE result is a CRITICAL HIT you gain a LARGE damage bonus. Your non CRITICAL result hits have a SMALL damage penalty.

armor_options.name: Single Block accelerator
armor_options.desc: Full auto no longer grants a number of shots equal to expertise result, instead it doubles the expertise bonus as additional damage.

armor_options.name: Sticky coating
armor_options.desc: Grenade will stick to any surface it hits, no deviation. (Athletic DC2 to remove). On critical faillures it sticks to the user.

armor_options.name: Suppressor
armor_options.desc: Removes muzzle flash and lowers noise of PHYSICAL weapons. Gain INV tag when the distance exceeds 10m.

armor_options.name: Tactical computer
armor_options.desc: After hitting a target once you can perform QUICK action to lock-on vs that target (use your ranged roll instead of CYBERINTEL).

armor_options.name: Tripod attachment
armor_options.desc: Your weapon is considered BRACED if you have not moved this round. Weapon size increase by 1

armor_options.name: Charge capacitor
armor_options.desc: Your energy weapon no longer needs to charge before usage (start combat with full AMMO) but your RECHARGE time is doubled.
